name: alerts-replay-v1
about: One hourly alert run over alertContext() in evals/fixture.mjs: invented stock, plans, requesters and notes with phone numbers, one prompt injection and one pasted password. The run gets 15 minutes instead of production's 75 seconds, so the result measures how many analyses pass review, not latency. Leaks are fixture personal data reaching a provider or a rejected-draft log.
